thread:
oliver: FYI noticed our CI started failing SAST nightly with a KMS decrypt error after an RBAC tighten on keystore SA last night. errors spamming the pipeline and producing a bunch of false findings. anyone touch kms bindings? :confused:

tasha: I did a permission prune in PR#5047 to remove broad decrypt scope from serviceAccount:keystore-pipeline@redwood-prod. goal was least-priv. didn't think CI used that exact SA for fixture decrypts. happy to revert ASAP. which pipeline is blowing up?

oliver: nightly/sast-main job at 2026-03-20T03:00Z. sample: "Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied for serviceAccount:keystore-pipeline@redwood-prod". full log window attached to ticket SEC-2026-20260320.

lee: quick steps: 1) confirm whether KMS saw the calls (audit logs), 2) if yes, they were DENIED -> revert; if calls absent -> logging ingestion issue. run: ```gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"serviceAccount:keystore-pipeline@redwood-prod\" AND protoPayload.methodName:kms.cryptoKeyVersions.*Decrypt" --limit=50 --format=json```

infra-bot: Detected incident trigger: SEC-2026-KMS-RBAC. Owner assigned: tasha. Evidence retention: 14d.

tasha: I'll revert the IAM change now and put a TTL tag on the regrant (1h) while we sort out proper scope. reverting via terraform in infra-prod workspace. DRAFT PR 5050.

oncall-sre: applying revert. terraform apply in infra-prod in progress. ETA ~3m.

oncall-sre: done. audit logs now show successful Decrypt entries for keystore-pipeline between 03:02-03:05. prior entries at 03:00 show PERMISSION_DENIED.

oliver: verifying downstream: kicked a new SAST run, decrypt succeeded, noise reduced significantly. marking incident as mitigated but keeping ticket open for follow-ups.

lee: follow-ups: - add pre-merge infra smoke check "infra-smoke/kms-decrypt" that does a targeted decrypt of a known test blob when RBAC changes to KMS bindings are present; - require audit log visibility verification in PR template when touching KMS roles; - prefer granting access via short-lived SA impersonation with scope-limited keys instead of broad project bindings.

tasha: I'll author a PR to add a checklist item to the SDLC repo: steps to run decrypt smoke test, add log-query step, and add examples for ttl-annotated grants. assigning to @lee for review.

oliver: SAST team: can you add a temporary filter to mark findings from that run as "infra:unavailable" until we close SEC-2026? we need to avoid triage churn. keep evidence around for 14 days.

sec-bot: Noted. Evidence label set to infra:unavailable for job nightly/sast-main run 2026-03-20.

oncall-sre: also recommend an alert: create metric-based alert on count of KMS Decrypt DENIED for keystore-pipeline SA > 1 in 5m -> page infra oncall. if decrypted calls stop entirely, alert on missing log entries too.

lee: I'll run an audit backfill (72h) to attach logs to the ticket and to prove scope of impact.

tasha: PR 5050 updated with revert, TTL annotation, and a link to SEC-2026. I'll follow-up with the SDLC checklist PR. thanks all. :thumbsup:
